text:
anna-r: Heads-up — I’m handing off oncall at 17:00 UTC tomorrow. Quick preflight: can people confirm they can do the checklist below from laptop (non-prod) before EOD?

- VPN & bastion access
- Pager delivery test
- Runbook open + bookmarks
- KMS access for key rotation ops

If anything is flaky, call it out here.

devon: I’ll take the handoff but can only do this from home network. Will test now.

leah: Thanks — I posted the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-preflight.md. It has the exact commands for dev/non-prod access and pager test.

oncall-bot: Scheduled pager test for @devon at 1782506800. Expect a call and SMS.

devon: Pager test arrived (call + SMS) ✅. VPN to corp-vpn OK, can reach bastion.

devon: Quick note — gcloud session to nonprod VMs fails with: "permission denied for resource projects/rdw-nonprod". I haven’t got KMS access.

leah: KMS is gated by the key-ops role. @infra-runbooks can you confirm devon has key-ops? There’s a short workaround in runbook for manual token if we need it for rotation.

infra-runbooks: Confirmed — devon was not in key-ops. I added him to the temporary group (expires in 7 days) and put a ticket in IAM for permanent add.

devon: Re-tested gcloud, now can access KMS. Running the key rotation dry-run:
```
# run locally in nonprod
gcloud kms keys versions destroy --key=my-rot-test --location=global --keyring=rdw-test
# revert via backup script in runbook if needed
```

leah: Nice. Also check the alerting webhook works from non-prod:
```
curl -i -X POST https://hooks.redwood.internal/alert-test -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALERT_TEST_TOKEN" -d '{"msg":"oncall preflight"}'
```

devon: Curl succeeded; webhook returned 200 and generated an alert in Ops dashboard.

anna-r: Thanks — VPN/pager/webhook/KMS all good from devon. leah, any outstanding manual steps?

leah: Two small FYIs: 1) vault creds for service accounts rotate every 24hrs in non-prod — make sure your vault token is fresh before running scripts; 2) the console bookmark for runbooks sometimes points to an old S3 object, clear cache if doc seems stale.

anna-r: Noted. I’ll paste the handoff note into the rota: "devon oncall 17:00–09:00 UTC (tomorrow). Preflight passed; temp KMS group provisioned; watch vault token expiry." :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded in rota. Reminder message will be sent 30m before shift.

devon: All set from my side. If someone wants to pair for first 30m tomorrow to watch latency spikes after deploy, I’m free.

leah: I can join first 15m to run post-deploy smoke checks. Add short checklist to rota: smoke-checks -> /runbooks/smoke-checklist.md

anna-r: Done. Thanks everyone — closing preflight thread.
